name: Grille
prior: Hieroglyphic Plume (Eurorack, 2024, ~$350): digital stereo pulsar oscillator after Roads with formant 'coupled' (relative to the fundamental) or 'decoupled', cluster 1-7 cycles per pulsaret, 7 morphable window contours, window modulation per pulsar/group, 'single channel burst masking at the left output ... channel masking when both outputs are used', wavefolder (VS: synthanatomy.com/2024/06/hieroglyphic-plume.html, analoguehaven.com/hieroglyphic/plume/manual.pdf, sonicstate.com 2024/04/30, matrixsynth.com 2024/05) = Grille's concept incl. the coupled/decoupled switch Grille lacks. Hamburg Audio Nuklear (VST/AU/VST3, 2011, v1.1.4): 'first instrument that integrates pulsar synthesis into a modern synthesizer', pitch = repetition rate with separate pulsaret frequency, 4 pulsar-train generators, 16 voices, 26 pulsaret waveforms, 16-step sequencer (VS: kvraudio.com/product/5163, kvraudio forum p=4638852, rekkerd.org/?p=39865). nuPG (Pietruszewski, SuperCollider; CTM 2021 'Synthetic Pulsar', VS: ctm-festival.de) and PulsarGenerator (Roads & de Campo 2001, S: synthesis.md 2.2). iPulsaret (apeSoft/Petrolati, iPad 2012, v3.6.x, AUv3, ~$9): 'all time-domain varieties of granular synthesis', 32 voices (VS: apps.apple.com/pg/app/ipulsaret/id565880268, synthtopia 2012/10/10, sonicstate 2012/10/11) = pulsar granular sampler on a tablet. Vela (Max for Live): granular sampler 'based on pulsar synthesis, with masking' (VS: cycling74.com/projects/vela). Cycling '74 forum: stochastic burst masking is 'the hard part', custom external (VS: cycling74.com/forums/pulsar-synthesis-help). Tone2 RayBlaster 'Impulse Modeling Synthesis' (VS: synthanatomy 2024/06); Plaits Formant/VOSIM/Pulsar window mode (S: 2.2; V: research/src/mi_plaits_grain_engine.cc). Name clashes: Qu-Bit Pulsar (burst generator), SOMA Pulsar-23 (VS: synthtopia.com/?p=85488). Browser: none found (searches for pulsar/pulsaret + Web Audio/JavaScript/AudioWorklet/Tone.js/p5 return only Gendy.js, genish.js, p5.Pulse; 'Collapsing Pulsar' 2026 single-file HTML synth is a cellular-automata synth, VS: ko-fi.com/s/b07b9df207, matrixsynth 2026/09). In Myzel: Stimme (glottal wave + formant bank, APP 4170-4255), Obertoene (buzz + bandpass spotlight, APP 4030-4113), Schwarm (coupled-FM insects with a 3rd-harmonic cricket and a 2-6-pulse chirp loop, APP 4262-4272), Koerner 'Zikaden' (generated cicada choir with sub-sample tymbal click trains, APP 2675-2700) -> Grille is the second formant source and the third insect. Not found: formant and masking on a touch axis inside a field instrument with a sequencer.
costNotes: Per voice (R: webaudio.md section 4): node 0.06 + 3 k-rate params 0.09; per pulsaret slot one sine-table read + one window-table read + 2 MAC ~ a table oscillator ~0.045, two overlapping slots 0.09; mask RNG / m:n counter once per period negligible -> ~0.25 (phone x1-1.5 -> <= 0.4). L3: two trains x 2 slots + second formant sine per slot + stereo write ~0.45-0.5. The idea's 0.3/0.55 is consistent. Must be a worklet: restarting the sine every pulsar period is not possible with native nodes at audio rate (WaveShaper-on-sawtooth would need a new curve per hoehe change and inherits band-limited-saw ripple); native BufferSource pulsarets only for f_p <= ~40 Hz (Koerner-scheduler regime, S: 2.2) = fallback for the rhythm regime only. Contract fits (R: section 10): envelopes native via burstEnv (APP 3517), Bebung via detune param, freq glide = rate glide with the formant held. Sub-sample period starts mandatory (as the Zikaden generator does, APP 2694-2697), else 1 % FM jitter noise at 1 kHz.
soundHeld: Weak as specified at Teilung 1: a single-cycle Gaussian pulsaret train is a harmonic series under a broad (Q ~ 1) formant hump = Obertoene's spotlight or Stimme with one formant; a buzz with a wah. Worse at Teilung >= 4: with the decoupled formant f_f = 180*2^(4.8y) the ear takes the pulsaret frequency as the pitch once the rate drops under ~50-60 Hz (A3/4 = 55 Hz, A3/16 = 13.75 Hz), so the heard pitch is the finger height (~950 Hz at y = 0.5), not the field note, and Bebung on the rate is inaudible. Fix: coupled formant by default (f_f = note x harmonic h(y), h quantised 1-24, Plume's coupled mode) with 'frei' as option, plus a Zyklen/cluster parameter (1-7 cycles) to narrow the formant; then the held note is a stepped-vowel impulse tone with masking that nothing in Myzel has.
soundBurst: Strong: gate 0.9*step (APP 5980) = 160-320 ms at 84 bpm, hit() 0.22 s (APP 5083) -> 2-17 pulsarets at 13-55 Hz = a chirp with a clear formant pitch, velocity -> mask density; with the coupled formant it lands on the scale. But the 'takt 3:1 + Teilung 4 = Grillen-Nacht im Tempo' claim fails: at A3 the 4-pulsar pattern repeats every 72.7 ms = 13.75 Hz, a subharmonic flutter, not rhythm; rhythm needs (m+n)*p >= 150 ms -> Teilung 8-16 and/or long rests (3:9, 4:12, 2:30; 4 pulses at 30 Hz, ~2 chirps/s is cricket-like) or a second chirp-rate mask layer (1-6 Hz, optionally bpm-synced).
failureModes: Decoupled formant: at Teilung >= 4 the heard pitch is the finger height, not the field note -> lanes play off-scale; default to a coupled, harmonic-quantised formant
m:n takt at pulsar granularity with m+n <= 8 = 7-14 Hz flutter, not tempo; needs long rests or a chirp-rate second mask
Teilung 1 = Obertoene/Stimme territory (broad single formant on a harmonic buzz); needs Zyklen/cluster parameter and masking in the defaults
Zahn window aliases up to the 5 kHz formant; truncated pulsarets click -> Gaussian/Hann at L1, polyBLEP edges, always two overlapping slots
Level: sqrt(d/p) compensation up to x8.4 at 1.4 % duty -> peaks far above the held level; cap x3, ear-weighted preset level, tilt above 2 kHz for phone speakers
Gestik: Bebung moves only the rate when the formant is decoupled -> inaudible at Teilung >= 8
Period starts must be sub-sample or high notes carry 1 % FM jitter noise
Catalogue: third insect after Schwarm and Zikaden; the name sells only the chirp regime, the text must sell the held regime ('sprechender Impulston')
verdict: Rare, not new: Roads' pulsar synthesis with burst/channel masking and a coupled/decoupled formant ships as the Hieroglyphic Plume Eurorack module (2024), as Hamburg Audio's Nuklear (2011), in nuPG/SuperCollider and the Max world, and as iPulsaret on iPad; nothing in a browser, and nothing with formant and masking under a finger. Worklet-feasible at about 0.25-0.3 units (L3 about 0.45-0.5), the cheapest engine class. Two spec errors must be fixed or it fails musically: with a decoupled formant the heard pitch at Teilung >= 4 is the finger height, not the field note (default to a coupled, harmonic-quantised formant), and m:n takt patterns at pulsar granularity give 7-14 Hz flutter, not rhythm (long rests or a chirp-rate second mask). The Puls hit - 2-17 pulsarets per gate, a chirp with a formant pitch - is its strongest form; the held note at Teilung 1 is Obertoene/Stimme territory and needs a Zyklen (cluster) parameter to stand out.
